channel.title: Real estate: Korean small and mid-cap filings
channel.description: New filings from Korean small and mid-cap companies in the real estate sector.

item.title: Hanwha REIT: Hanwha REIT reports FY ended Oct 2026 revenue of KRW 94.6bn, up 74.40%, and net income of KRW 51.3bn, up 194.38%.
JR Global Reit: JR Global REIT amended its filing: Seoul Rehabilitation Court extended the ARS deferral of its rehabilitation commencement decision to December 13, 2026.
IGIS Value Plus REIT: Igis Value Plus REIT reported FY ended Aug 31, 2026 consolidated revenue down 22.0% to KRW 16.5bn.
SK Reit: SK REIT reported Q3 2026 provisional revenue of KRW 43.9bn, up 26.8% year on year and down 10.6% from the prior quarter.
SK Reit: SK REIT reported Q3 2026 consolidated revenue of KRW 65.2bn, down 18.6% from the prior quarter, and net income down 38.3%.
